stories.title: Add marketing design tokens
stories.acceptance_criteria: index.css has --night, --cream, --amber, --amber-l, --muted, --rule, --card. Body/app background uses --night. DM Sans + Playfair Display loaded.

stories.title: Layout app shell dark theme
stories.acceptance_criteria: Layout (app-shell) uses dark bg, cream text, amber accents, marketing card/border style.

stories.title: Restyle LoginPage and FirstSetupPage to match marketing
stories.acceptance_criteria: Login and FirstSetup pages use dark background (--night), cream text, amber accents, DM Sans/Playfair Display. No changes to HTML files.

stories.title: Restyle VenueLandingPage to match marketing
stories.acceptance_criteria: VenueLandingPage uses same dark/cream/amber theme as marketing.

stories.title: Remove duplicate tabs bar
stories.acceptance_criteria: Only one navigation bar (Clock, Timesheet, Exports, Manager, Venue) visible in Layout. No TopNav + app-shell__nav repetition.

stories.title: All pages dark theme (Clock, Timesheet, Export, Manager, VenueSettings)
stories.acceptance_criteria: ClockPage, TimesheetPage, ExportPage, ManagerPage, VenueSettingsPage use marketing style: dark bg, cream text, amber accents, --rule borders on cards/buttons/forms.

stories.title: TopNav, Footer, buttons, cards in marketing style
stories.acceptance_criteria: TopNav, Footer, Container, btn-primary, btn-secondary, cards, inputs, badges match marketing theme.

stories.title: API returns current user pay rates
stories.acceptance_criteria: GET /auth/me (or equivalent) includes standard_rate, enhanced_rate, supervisor_rate for current user.

stories.title: Pay rates info box shows real data
stories.acceptance_criteria: Layout pay-rate-info panel displays user's actual rates (Standard £X/hr, Enhanced £Y/hr, Supervisor £Z/hr) or 'Not set'. Updates when data changes.

stories.title: Final verification
stories.acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes. Full app matches marketing vibe. No duplicate tabs. Pay rates panel shows real data.
